Purpose of script: To check the model results and plot it

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
source("fun_mod_pl.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read data 
```{r}
selpat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "multi_mmr", "multi_dtp", "pn", "hib", 
              "multi_men", "hbv", "multi_ipv")

# Read in the data 
dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  if(x %in% c("varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "multi_mmr")) {vac <- "v1"
  } else {vac <- "vl"}
  dat <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/data_brms_{x}_{vac}_s08.rds"))
  if(x %in% c("multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv")) {
    dat <- dat %>%
      relocate(imm_val_s1_anti_polio_1, imm_val_s1_anti_polio_2, imm_val_s1_anti_polio_3)
  }
  return(dat)
  }, simplify = FALSE)

datlong_l <- sapply(str_subset(selpat_l, "multi"), function(x) {
  dat_l[[x]] %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(!c(starts_with("censored"), starts_with("imm_val_s0"))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("imm_val_s1"), names_to = "imm_name", values_to = "imm_val_s1",
                 cols_vary = "slowest") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_remove_all(imm_name, "imm_val_s1_"))}, 
  simplify = FALSE)

datlong_l <- c(datlong_l, dat_l[str_subset(selpat_l, "multi", negate = TRUE)])

# Types of clustering 
clu_name <- "reg_3"
```

# Read models 
```{r}
mod_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  if(x %in% c("varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "multi_mmr")) {vac <- "v1"
  } else {vac <- "vl"}
  if(str_detect(x, "multi")) {gauss <- "_gauss"
  } else {gauss <- ""}
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/perpathogen/{x}/bm{vac}_s08_{x}_csi_{clu_name}{gauss}.rds"))}, simplify = FALSE)
```

# Make predictions and plot ecdf 
```{r}
# Predictions for the single values 
pred_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  pred_basal <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/pred_basal_dat_{x}.rds"), {
    pred <- posterior_predict(mod_l[[x]], ndraws = 10)
  })
  return(pred_basal)
}, simplify = FALSE)

# Prepare data 
pred_ppc_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  if(str_detect(x, "multi") == FALSE) {
    ppc_data(dat_l[[x]]$imm_val_s1, pred_l[[x]]) %>%
      left_join(dat_l[[x]] %>%
                ungroup() %>%
                mutate(y_id = c(1:length(dat_l[[x]]$study))) %>%
                select(y_id, censored))
    } else if (str_detect(x, "multi") == TRUE) {
    sapply(str_subset(names(dat_l[[x]]), "imm_val_s1"), function(subx) {
      ppc_data(dat_l[[x]][[subx]], pred_l[[x]][,,str_remove_all(subx, "_")]) %>%
        left_join(dat_l[[x]] %>%
                    ungroup() %>%
                    mutate(y_id = c(1:length(dat_l[[x]]$study))) %>%
                    rename(censored = str_replace(subx, "imm_val_s1", "censored")) %>%
                    select(y_id, censored))
      }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
        bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
        mutate(imm_name = str_remove(imm_name, "imm_val_s1_"))
    }
}, simplify = FALSE)

# Plot it 
bind_rows(pred_ppc_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, "")) %>%
    filter(censored == 0) %>%
    mutate(is_y = case_when(is_y == FALSE ~ "Posterior predictions",
                            is_y == TRUE ~ "Observed data")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = log(value), color = is_y, group = rep_id)) + 
    stat_ecdf() + 
    scale_x_continuous() + 
    scale_color_manual("", values = c("firebrick2", "grey")) + 
    facet_wrap(~pathogen+imm_name)
pred_ppc_l$rota
```

# Plot the conditional effects for all the pathogens 
```{r}
# Obtain the conditional effects 
ce_dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function (x) readRDS(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/ce_dat_{x}.rds")),
                   simplify = FALSE)

# Obtain the conditional effects with spaguetti 
spa_dat_l <- sapply(selpat_l, function(x) {
  pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/ce_dat_spa_{x}.rds"), {
    ce_dat_spa <- conditional_effects(mod_l[[x]], resolution = 52, 
                                      effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1:{clu_name}"),
                                      spaghetti = TRUE, ndraws = 100, re_formula = NULL)
    
    spa_dat <- sapply(ce_dat_spa, function(subx) {
        attr(subx, "spaghetti") %>%
                group_by(reg_3, sample__) %>%
                mutate(estimate_norm = (estimate__/mean(estimate__, na.rm = TRUE)))
      }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name")
    
    return(spa_dat)
  }) 
}, simplify = FALSE)
# Do not change this formula as it was a pain to obtain the spaguetti for mmr 

pat_tidy_names <- c("Rotavirus", "Varicella zoster virus", "Measles virus", "Mumps virus", 
              "Rubella virus", "C. diphtheriae", "C. tetani", "B. pertussis", 
              "S. pneumoniae", "H. influenzae Type B", 
              "N. meningitidis \n (serotypes c and a)", "Hepatitis B virus",
              "Polio virus \n (serotypes 1, 2 and 3)")
names(pat_tidy_names) <- c("rota", "varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "dipht", "tetan", 
                     "pertupt", "pn", "hib", "multi_men", "hbv","multi_ipv")
```

## Data for the plot 
```{r}
dat_pl1 <- bind_rows(spa_dat_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(clu = clu_name) %>%
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=immvals1anti).+?(?=\\.)"),
         pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
  select(pathogen, imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu, estimate__, sample__, estimate_norm) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(ce_dat_l, .id = "pathogen") %>%
              rename(estimate_mean = estimate__) %>%
              select(-pid) %>%
              distinct()) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, imm_name, clu) %>%
  mutate(estimate_mean_norm = estimate_mean/mean(estimate_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""), 
         sam_imm = paste0(sample__,"_",pathogen,imm_name), 
         pat_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtp") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = pathogen),
         pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy,  levels = names(pat_tidy_names), labels = pat_tidy_names),
         imm_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_men", "multi_ipv") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = NA)) 
```

# Plots 
```{r}
pl1_temp <- dat_pl1 %>%
  filter(clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
  group_by(sam_imm) %>%
  mutate(date_min = vac_week_v1[estimate_norm == min(estimate_norm)],
         date_max = vac_week_v1[estimate_norm == max(estimate_norm)]) %>%
  group_by(pat_tidy) %>%
  mutate(date_min_mean = mean(date_min)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = estimate_norm - 1, group = sam_imm, color = date_max)) + 
    geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = estimate_mean_norm - 1, group = imm_tidy), color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect in temperate regions") + 
    scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing",
                          breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52),
                          colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), 
                                    rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                          guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                                                 title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                 barheight = 0.8)) + 
    facet_wrap(reorder(pat_tidy, -abs(date_max - 25))~., scales = "free", nrow = 3, dir = "v") + 
  theme(legend.position = c(1, 0.5),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = "right")
```

# Plot the conditional effects for all the pathogens 
```{r}
mod_rota_reg6a <- readRDS(file = "outputs/perpathogen/rota/bmvl_s08_rota_csi_reg_6a.rds")

# Obtain the conditional effects 
ce_dat_rota_reg6a <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/ce_dat_rota_reg6a.rds"), {
  lapply(conditional_effects(mod_rota_reg6a, resolution = 52, effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1:reg_6a")),
          as.data.frame) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "imm_name") %>%
    mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=\\.immvals1anti).+?(?=_pi)")) %>%
    mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
    rename(clu = all_of("reg_6a")) %>%
    mutate(clu = as.character(clu)) %>%
    select(imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu, estimate__, lower__, upper__) %>%
    left_join(dat_l[["rota"]] %>%
                mutate(pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
                distinct(vac_week_v1, pi_vac_week_v1)) %>%
    left_join(dat_l[["rota"]] %>%
                rename(clu = all_of("reg_6a")) %>%
                mutate(clu = as.character(clu),
                       pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
                group_by(pi_vac_week_v1, vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
                summarise(tot = n())) %>%
    mutate(estimate__ = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = estimate__),
           lower__ = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = lower__),
           upper__ = case_when(is.na(tot) ~ NA, .default = upper__))
  })

# Obtain the conditional effects with spaguetti 
spa_dat_rota_reg6a <- pomp::bake(file = glue("outputs/dfs_figures/ce_dat_spa_rota_reg6a.rds"), {
    ce_dat_spa <- conditional_effects(mod_rota_reg6a, resolution = 52, 
                                      effects = glue("pi_vac_week_v1:reg_6a"),
                                      spaghetti = TRUE, ndraws = 100, re_formula = NULL)
    spa_dat <- sapply(ce_dat_spa, function(subx) {
        attr(subx, "spaghetti") %>%
                group_by(reg_6a, sample__) %>%
                mutate(estimate_norm = (estimate__/mean(estimate__, na.rm = TRUE)))
      }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
      bind_rows(.id = "imm_name")
    
    return(spa_dat)
  }) 

dat_pl2 <- spa_dat_rota_reg6a %>%
  mutate(pathogen = "rota") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(clu = "reg_6a") %>%
  mutate(imm_name = str_extract(imm_name, "(?<=immvals1anti).+?(?=\\.)"),
         pi_vac_week_v1 = round(pi_vac_week_v1, digits = 11)) %>%
  select(pathogen, imm_name, pi_vac_week_v1, clu, estimate__, sample__, estimate_norm) %>%
  left_join(ce_dat_rota_reg6a %>%
              rename(estimate_mean = estimate__) %>%
              distinct()) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, imm_name, clu) %>%
  mutate(estimate_mean_norm = estimate_mean/mean(estimate_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(imm_name = replace_na(imm_name, ""), 
         sam_imm = paste0(sample__,"_",pathogen,imm_name), 
         pat_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_mmr", "multi_dtp") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = pathogen),
         pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy,  levels = names(pat_tidy_names), labels = pat_tidy_names),
         imm_tidy = case_when(pathogen %in% c("multi_men", "multi_ipv") ~ imm_name,
                              .default = NA)) 

pl2 <- dat_pl2 %>%
  group_by(sam_imm) %>%
  mutate(date_min = vac_week_v1[estimate_norm == min(estimate_norm)],
         date_max = vac_week_v1[estimate_norm == max(estimate_norm)]) %>%
  group_by(pat_tidy) %>%
  mutate(date_min_mean = mean(date_min)) %>%
  mutate(clu = factor(clu, levels = c("3_Tropical", "2_Subtropical", "1_Temperate", 
                                      "4_Tropical south", "5_Subtropical south"),
                      labels = c("Tropical north", "Subtropical north", "Temperate north",
                                 "Tropical south", "Subtropical south"))) %>%
   ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = estimate_norm - 1, group = sam_imm, color = date_max)) + 
    geom_line(alpha = 0.2) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = estimate_mean_norm - 1, group = imm_tidy), color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52)) + 
    scale_y_continuous("Rotavirus \n Conditional effect") + 
    scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing",
                          breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52),
                          colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), 
                                    rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                          guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                                                 title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                 barheight = 0.8)) + 
    facet_wrap(.~clu, scales = "free", nrow = 2, dir = "h") + 
  theme(legend.position = c(1, 0.25),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = "right")

ggsave(pl2, file = "outputs/figures/ce_reg6a_rotavirus.pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4)
```
